justification: Both surfaces include human or anthropomorphic forms and some circular/geometric marks, but these are generic correspondences; the closest shared element is the use of circular motifs, though in A they appear as repeated rosettes in a border and in B as parts of a frontal figure. The biggest difference is that A shows a horizontally organized procession with repeated profile figures and an animal, while B shows a single highly schematic frontal anthropomorphic figure with internal symbols.
